description: Round 1 Solicitation Electric Fuel Corridor Groups (updated December 2023) is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. This layer includes the groups for Round 1 of California's NEVI Funding Program. Data Dictionary: Corridor Segment - A portion of a highway corridor. Corridor Group - A group of one or more corridor segments. Alternative Fuel Corridor - The U.S. Department of Transportation Fed. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are CAOpenData, California Energy Commission, California Natural Resources Agency, FTD, NEVI. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
